name: cx-box-carry
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is picked up again after each fall: `holding_box` may have been true before the fall, so the response can be satisfied without a later pickup. The task requires a pickup after the fall; use `Response(box_fell, holding_box)`? The supplied template cannot express a later pickup when `holding_box` is true before the fall.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box there, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, be carrying it again afterward.
